title: The agile model: the role of testing in a short cycle

videos.script: In two thousand and one, seventeen people wrote one page. Four values, twelve principles, and a name for a family of methods. Agile. {{manifesto}} One value says working software is the measure of progress. For that to mean anything, somebody has to know, every two weeks, that the software works. {{working}} That changes testing from a phase into a rhythm. {{rhythm}} Unless the team builds for eight days and hands everything over on the ninth. Then it is the waterfall again, shrunk to a sprint. {{mini}} The lesson draws the two weeks both ways, and names the habits that keep testing in step with building. {{habits}} Then a map of four quadrants. Tests that support the team, and tests that critique the product. Facing the business, or the technology. {{quadrants}} And the problems agile leaves behind. Testing debt, regression that grows, and the tester invited too late. {{end}}
